what: Pressing the glass dock at the bottom center of the screen (accent color 80% + 2rem blur) folds its background from 27.6rem wide to a 5rem square over .6s power3.inOut, the section name slides up out of view, the icon and burger are pushed 10rem to each side and vanish in .3s, and the close button rises from below. The menu panel above the dock unfolds from 0 to 1 around its base, links rise from 150% below at .02 intervals over .8s, and the header and buttons turn on .3s later. It opens by itself on reaching the end of the scroll (progress 1), with Back to top rising instead of close, and closes when you leave the end

options.slide: Distance the icons and burger are pushed away, default 10rem
options.end: 0 means it does not open by itself at scroll end
options.--fx-bottom·--fx-height·--fx-width·--fx-: Dock bottom offset · height · width · menu board width
options.[data-fx-part]: dock, bg, panel required / mark, title, open, close, top, panel-bg, panel-head, link, cta optional

note: In the original, if a section name is long it travels back and forth over px/15 seconds in x, and when paging, the section name swaps by going up in .6 power3.in then coming from below in .6 power3.out (setTitle in the site’s shared.js). This part includes only collapse and expand plus opening at the end of scroll. The original’s scroll-end check uses Lenis progress, so the copy and the part measure by the window (or the given scroller) position instead.
